Keeping AI-Written Code Under Control: Field Notes from AllyOS

Each post takes one real problem from AllyOS and walks through the problem, the fix and the measured numbers. Client and internal company data are never published.

RSS feed · 中文

  • Tools & Tips · 2026-11-28

    Fix Python subprocess UnicodeDecodeError on Windows for good

    Without an explicit encoding, Python decodes subprocess output and encodes print() with the OS code page (gbk on Chinese Windows). Telling the AI in project instructions was not enough, so AllyOS runs two AST checks before every push - every text-mode subprocess call must pass encoding="utf-8", and every script's main() must pin stdout to UTF-8. Scanning 612 files takes about 1.5 s, and the checks caught 7 AI misses in 30 days.

  • Incident Review · 2026-11-27

    Why Claude Code Subagent Worktrees Silently Break Your Git Hooks

    When Claude Code creates a worktree, including a subagent's isolated worktree, it rewrites the relative core.hooksPath in the shared .git/config to an absolute path, so every unpinned worktree runs the main checkout's hooks. Run one idempotent repair script from SessionStart, PostToolUse (EnterWorktree) and SubagentStart; we measured recovery in 68 ms.
